text.p: Fritz Fahrni, chief executive and president of Sulzer Technology Corp. said the prospect for the company's profits in 1997 and 1998 was positive.
In a statement released ahead of a news conference, Fahrni, noted that the development of profits in 1995 and 1996 was "unsatisfactory."
"We consider profit development in 1988 through 1994, but also the profit prospect for this year and the coming year, as positive," Fahrni said, without elaborating further.
Last week Sulzer said 1996 orders fell three percent to 5.5 billion Swiss francs and confirmed that net profit will be seriously affected by restructuring charges and extraordinary expenses.
In 1995 Sulzer reported a net profit of 92 million francs.
The news conference was called in connection with Sulzer's announcement earlier today that it would list its medical technology unit Medica on the stock market.
